autonomy.radar: X- and S-band ARPA: targets out to 12 nm, the collision avoidance's tracks
autonomy.ais: class A transponder: the others see it, it sees them
autonomy.lidar_cameras: 360 deg lidar ring, day and IR cameras: small craft, buoys, swimmers, the drones on deck
autonomy.gnss_ins: dual RTK GNSS + fibre-optic INS: DP over the bed, the pads' motion for the drones
autonomy.comms: LEO satcom + 4G/LTE + UHF to shore; 900 MHz + LTE to the drones; ADS-B in
autonomy.colregs: COLREGs rules 8-17 in the autopilot: give way / stand on, a closest-approach limit of 0.3 nm
autonomy.supervision: one shore operator per 3 vessels: alarms, a remote takeover (teleop) when a fault asks
autonomy.guard: the guard picture: radar, turret, ring cameras, AIS and the drones' tracks fused; contacts classified with the operator; the escalation ladder's interlocks (no step above a hail without a live operator)
autonomy.boat_control: Barracuda's MANET and UHF command link from the mast, its takeover and lost-link rendezvous

crate_loader.what: the payload loader: an arm on a rail along the flight deck and down the lift - an EO/IR pod or a cargo crate into a Gannet's hook or a Fulmar's bay

swap_robot.what: a gantry between the pads and the battery room: the pack out of a locked drone's sled, a charged one in

deck_tug.what: a low tug with a gripper: drones between the pads, the lift and the catapult cradle; a Fulmar out of the net

cleaner.what: a magnetic crawler: washes the pads' grids, the deck, the radar and camera windows; inspects welds and the net

boat_ramp.what: the stern ramp's capture hook, haul-in winch and cradle lashings; the refuelling coupling and shore power for Barracuda

ramp.system: stern ramp between the demihulls: a capture hook for the bow eye, a haul-in winch, a cradle with keel guides at its top

cycle.launch: release the lashings 20 s, slack the winch and slide down the wet ramp 40 s, jets on and away 30 s
cycle.recovery: line up astern at 4 kn 60 s, drive into the ramp's mouth, the hook takes the bow eye 30 s, haul in 90 s, cradle, lash, refuel and shore power couple 60 s

bay.boat_mast: folded in the bay: mast up it would hit the flight deck

turret.what: long-range EO/IR turret: HD day 1920 px (0.5 deg narrow), cooled MWIR 1280 px (0.9 deg narrow), eye-safe laser rangefinder 20 km

camera_ring.what: Zarco's ring of day 4K and uncooled LWIR 640 cameras, 60 deg each (kept)

X.what: X-band ARPA, 8 ft array: small craft, the collision avoidance's tracks

S.what: S-band ARPA: through rain and heavy clutter, ships at range

lidar_m.note: the 360 deg lidar ring's class ranges (assumed)

sonar.on_dp_near_the_jacket: thrusters' noise and the jacket's reverberation roughly halve those ranges
sonar.verdict: not worth it on the carrier: it moves with the guard picture and works on DP, noisy, beside a steel jacket that clutters it; the underwater layer is Squilla's (resident at the jacket). If the platform's owner wants diver detection it belongs fixed on the jacket (task 5's dock is a candidate), not on Esmeralda.

hailer.what: long-range acoustic hailer, 160 dB class at 1 m, 15 deg beam at 2 kHz, on the mast's pan-tilt

searchlights.what: two LED searchlights on the mast's wings, remote pan-tilt, slaved to the turret

water_cannon.what: bow monitor on a 1.5 m pedestal; electric pump off the gensets' bus in the starboard hull's fore peak, its own sea chest

flare_launcher.space_reserved: a 0.5 x 0.5 m foundation on the mast house roof, 60 kg
flare_launcher.why_not: pyrotechnics from a civilian unmanned vessel: distress signals are reserved (COLREGs Annex IV); illuminating or warning flares near a craft are a rules-of-engagement question for the flag state and the platform's operator - not assumed. Non-pyrotechnic alternative: self-locating datum marker buoys (a light and an AIS/GNSS beacon) dropped to mark a contact's track - also not fitted until agreed.

effectors.vhf_hail: DSC and voice on ch 16, AIS safety messages (Zarco's radios)

port.plus: the payload workshop (EO/IR and cargo pods), the payload loader's track

starboard.plus: the battery room with the chargers

hangar_bays.fulmar_stowage: wing along the bay, fuselage athwartships (2.1 m in a 2.5 m bay)

changed_vs_zarco.unchanged: hulls, propulsion (service 10 kn, max 14.6 kn), autonomy mast, flight deck (4 pads, catapult, net), deck closure Hs 2.0 m
